decisions.reason: The booking exclusion applies to the master site; the reusable template is scoped to location sites and remains unchanged.
Booking ownership does not change the shared Smash Room brand identity or its application.
The source confirms that location sites handle bookings but does not change their existing Wix Bookings platform or scope.
Removing booking functionality from the master site does not alter its visual reference or layout characteristics.
Assigning bookings to location sites is consistent with, but does not modify, the existing per-location booking, calendar, revenue, sales, and management isolation.
